docs: Contacts content: the heading, a description and an ordered list of teams or channels to reach, each with an icon picture, a name, a line and an action. One object is valid in every contacts layout (cards in two or three columns, rows).

description.docs: one paragraph under the heading; empty: none

items.docs: the contacts, in the order they are shown

id.docs: stable key of the entry (the Codex entry id)

image.docs: address of the icon picture; none: the placeholder

title.docs: the name of the team or the channel

description.docs: one line: the address, the phone or the hours; empty: none

actionLabel.docs: the label of the action; the link is drawn when the label and the address are both set
